ev.q: CDC analyzed data from the 2012–2022 National Immunization Survey-Child (NIS-Child) to assess trends in vaccination coverage
Percentage point differences in vaccination coverage between VFC-eligible and non–VFC-eligible children were analyzed using Z-tests
coverage with ≥1 dose of MMR, rotavirus vaccine, and the combined 7-vaccine series was 89.6%, 71.0%, and 61.4%

coverage was 3.8 (≥1 MMR dose), 11.5 (2–3 doses of rotavirus vaccine), and 13.8 (combined 7-vaccine series)
